description: Definition of the AWS::QuickSight::Customization Resource Type.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name of the namespace-scoped account customization, arn:{Partition}:quicksight:{Region}:{AccountId}:customization/namespace/{Namespace}. Returned by the service and used as the primary identifier.

AwsAccountId.description: The AWS account that owns the customization. Supplied by CloudFormation from the invoking account rather than by the template, so it is read-only.

DefaultTheme.description: The ARN of the theme applied by default in the QuickSight console for this namespace. May be an AWS-managed starter theme such as arn:{Partition}:quicksight::aws:theme/MIDNIGHT or a theme owned by this account.

Namespace.description: The QuickSight namespace the customization applies to. One customization exists per (account, region, namespace), so this is create-only: changing it addresses a different resource.

Tags.description: Tags applied to the customization. QuickSight rejects any key prefixed aws: or quicksight:, so CloudFormation system tags are not propagated.
